opening.comment: Greet the caller with your own name as well as the company name, for example "Hi, this is Sam from Tidewell."

verification.quote: Can I have your full name and order number or postcode?
verification.comment: Good job confirming the caller's full name and order number before discussing the order.

understanding.quote: I sent a return back two weeks ago and I still haven't had my refund.
understanding.comment: You captured the refund issue accurately and did not ask for details the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Refunds take 10 to yeah 14 working days after we receive the item, so it'll be another week or two.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Our policy pays refunds within 5 working days of the return reaching the warehouse, so please check the timeline before quoting it.

process_compliance.quote: You'll get an email the day it's paid.
process_compliance.comment: No hold, damage, bank dispute or goodwill step applied to this call, so no process step was missed.

communication.quote: I understand, it's worrying when money is outstandin.
communication.comment: You acknowledged the caller's worry politely, which is what the scorecard asks for.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help you with?
closing.comment: You asked if there was anything else and closed politely, and you told the caller to expect an email when the refund is paid.
